title: French-Style Stir-Fried Nuts
description: A simple and quick French-inspired dish that combines the crunch of almonds with the savory flavors of a stir-fry. Enjoy as a snack or as a side dish.
instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
2. Add the olive oil and swirl it around to coat the pan.
3. Add the garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
4. Add the almonds and sauté until lightly toasted, about 2-3 minutes.
5. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
6. Add the butter and stir until melted.
